title: Textured firearm ammunition and complete vendor catalog, 2026-11-04
assumptions: 2026-11-04: scenario assumptions, not telemetry: 1/5/20 participating players, 100/1000/10000 expended rounds per player-day.

Before and after Survival/Adventure spend one iron nugget-equivalent per round: legacy plain nuggets remain accepted; a precise crafting recipe turns one vanilla nugget into one round. No reverse recipe, shop or monetary payout is added.
Creative remains unlimited and never writes free loaded rounds. Event ammunition remains match-scoped and cannot load ordinary-world firearms.

All36 existing vendor guns gain firing; baseline12 specs and existing acquisition/reward rules are preserved. New variants reuse class profiles with bounded capacities/rates. Indirect kill throughput can change and is unmeasured.
Existing EconomyShopGUI SELL and planned SELL-to-contract transition remain unchanged. No shop prices or monetary values are assumed live.
Zombies uses session-local points and escrowed event items only; native mob XP/drops and external reward hooks must be prevented by the controller. No Vault or tokens payout is introduced.

Zombies point scenarios are one solo run per player-day completing5/8/10 waves before ending; all kills credited to that player, no purchases. Up to30minutes per run and1/5/20participants imply at most10host-hours/day, within one shared host. These are upper wallet scenarios, not telemetry. Every point is destroyed at restoration; purchases only move part of that destruction earlier.

flows.basis: At equal expended rounds, one existing nugget or one cartridge crafted1:1 is consumed. Crafting conversion alone changes representation, not the iron-equivalent supply.
Scenario aggregate includes starting500 points, exact kill-kind awards and wave-clear bonuses for5/8/10cleared solo waves; no persistent currency is issued.

In the no-purchase scenarios the whole wallet expires on restoration. Purchases spend points earlier, so this expiry amount is reduced by exactly the earlier spend; never add both full expiry and purchases.
